reused: The frozen 100 targets and original ground-truth residue identities are retained. All three configurations are recomputed using canonical residue numbering. All prior results remain preserved. Within this comparison learned and learned-plm use the identical complete NMA/alpha candidate pool.

residue_numbering.method: For ALL three configurations, actual input residues are renumbered 1..N with reversible mapping to author numbers and insertion codes. Amino-acid identities, coordinates, B factors and occupancies retained. Reference identities mapped using the same table. Avoids original Lacuna digit-only PLM parser dropping minus signs and residue model lacking insertion codes.

settings.precision: Official Lacuna automatic GPU fp16, probability linear head float32

primary: Top-5 native pocket residue IoU>=0.25 against frozen CryptoBench author annotation union.
inference: Paired target bootstrap 10000 samples seed20261023; exact two-sided McNemar; Holm correction for two planned primary comparisons: PLM-vs-P2Rank and PLM-vs-learned. Other analyses descriptive.
failures: Fixed denominator 100; no target replacement; no fallback to learned accepted as PLM.
caveats: Additional PLM run follows observation of the baseline results, so this is an incremental comparison, not a fully blinded prospective study.
Frozen reference is residue annotation union, not a newly reconstructed holo-contact main pocket; published headline scores are not directly reproduced.
Supervised ranker/head training folds were checked; absence of these sequences from ESM-2 unsupervised pretraining is not established.
